First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 19 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's a drop ride: if you can't hold the pace, you'll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the GSD Saturday Ride group ride

A 62-mile Saturday drop ride from downtown Franklin. The A group rides in the low 20s and the B group holds about 19 mph. Both regroup at two collection points. It is pitched at intermediate to advanced riders.
